description: The term with a positive literal at each true coordinate of a row and a negative literal at each false coordinate is true exactly on that row.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.eval_rowTerm.{u} {α : Type u} {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → α) (r : Fin n → Bool)
  (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Valuation α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.eval v
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.termFormula (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.rowTerm p r)) =
      true ↔
    v ∘ p = r
